name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: R1 is a goal, not a rule, so the machine has no final state and no way to pay 11. Add a final state for the goal and a pending promise to pay the reward when it is met.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) is owed again on every step siren_ringing is true, because the task only requires it to happen once. Make it soft; keep the hard Existence(at_exit)

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit, u1) -> 11
